newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end weaker amid U.S. rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end weaker amid U.S. rate fears.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended weaker, but did not fall as far as Bonos and Bunds, amid concerns that the U.S. could raise rates soon, dealers said. Spreads against Bunds steady.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 68 bps vs 68 bps
Portuguese bonds ended weaker, but did not drop as far as Bonos and Bunds, amid concerns over a possible rise in U.S. interest rates soon, dealers said.
"The Portuguese market is doing better than other markets as some buyers are emerging at present levels," said one operator.
Another said that if U.S. Treasuries continued to fall, the Portuguese market would follow suit tomorrow.
